# Drone Survey Costa Rica
> Professional LiDAR drone mapping, aerial photography, and GPS surveying across Costa Rica

## About
Drone Survey Costa Rica (DroneSurveyCR.com) is a professional aerial surveying company based in San Jose, Costa Rica. We specialize in LiDAR mapping using DJI Matrice 300 RTK with Zenmuse L1 sensor, delivering centimeter-accurate topographic data. We serve all regions of Costa Rica including San Jose, Guanacaste, Caribbean coast, South Pacific, and Central Valley. Operating since 2017 with 120+ clients served and a 5.0-star rating across 25 Google reviews.

## Services
- **LiDAR Drone Mapping** — Centimeter-accurate topographic surveys using Zenmuse L1 (240,000 pts/sec, 3 returns). Penetrates forest canopy.
- **GPS/RTK Surveying** — DJI D-RTK 2 base station for precise geopositioning. Plano Catastro compliant.
- **Aerial Video & Photography** — 4K cinematic drone footage for real estate, construction, and marketing.
- **Topographic Maps** — Contour maps, DEM, DSM, orthomosaics delivered in AutoCAD/GIS formats.

## Emerging Technology
- **Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)** — We are tracking and testing Gaussian splatting, which turns drone imagery into photorealistic, explorable 3D scenes (ideal for remote real-estate buyers and site visualization). It complements, and does not replace, our survey-grade LiDAR and photogrammetry. Not yet a formal service; ask us about pairing a splat with a survey. See: https://www.dronesurveycr.com/blog/gaussian-splatting-drone-costa-rica.html

## Pricing
- Base fee: $1,000 USD per project (covers up to 5 hectares)
- Per hectare: $80 USD additional
- Drone video: $400 half day / $800 full day
- Delivery: 72 hours standard

## Coverage
All of Costa Rica: San Jose, Guanacaste, Puntarenas, Limon, Alajuela, Cartago, Heredia
